notes.title: Two-Year Kickstarter Anniversary!
notes.notes:
[h2]NEW TRAILER[/h2]
We've uploaded a new trailer as a part of our TWO Year Celebration of the Kickstarter Campaign. Enjoy!

[previewyoutube=lwvx3ksnOQs;full][/previewyoutube]

We also posted our last update so anyone could publicly view it (as in, more can view it than just Backers of the Kickstarter campaign); one thing of note - that we've commented on in updates but not too much otherwise - was that due to the Kickstarter success, more care and effort will consequently be put into making Crowsworn the best as it can be (in contrast to if the campaign had only hit the initial funding goal).

Here is a snippet from Tuesday's [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/mongooserodeo/crowsworn-a-dark-and-mysterious-action-packed-metroidvania/posts/3879584]update[/url]:
[i]"In some of the previous updates we discussed that the game is going to be taking longer to finish than the initially planned for December 2023 release date. We shed some light on the reasons for this in the previous updates, but for posterity we'll discuss it again.

The delayed release is primarily a result of raising more than 10x the amount of funds we had initially planned for. This basically means need to make a game that is 10x bigger / better than what we initially planned for."[/i]

Don't get hung up on the "10x" term in a literal sense; essentially, the team wants to make sure that Crowsworn rises to meet the now larger expectations of our supporters, so we're going to take our time and make it as great as it can be, rather than try to meet the original estimated fulfillment date.

Cheers everyone!

notes.title: An Unworthy Thank You Gift!
notes.notes:
Hey gang!

We've hit some great new milestones lately but on a more personal note, Aleks Kuzmanovic has generously added his game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/613190/Unworthy/]Unworthy[/url] as a gift to [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/mongooserodeo/crowsworn-a-dark-and-mysterious-action-packed-metroidvania?ref=1x7fst]backers of Crowsworn[/url] (at $20 CAD tier and above).

https://store.steampowered.com/app/613190/Unworthy/

[h3]A message from Aleks (Update #8):[/h3]
[i]"Since the campaign started I've legitimately been in awe at the level of support we've been getting for Crowsworn... it's actually insane when you think about it! (LIKE ACTUALLY INSANE!!!). I've been honestly been thinking if we're WORTHY of the amount of this support (pun very much intended!). This has further got me thinking... what can we possibly do to show our appreciation for all of this ridiculous support? Are we doing enough? Well anyways...  one thing I thought I'd do is throw in a complimentary Steam copy of my first game Unworthy (my breakthrough title if you will) for everyone who has backed the project at the $20 and above. I recently got the Steam keys approved! Thank you Valve!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40456999/277f3f340f09fe4be14b1b422cc40ef9d876ebe1.jpg[/img]

The game is incredibly personal to me, as it was truly a trial by fire for me. It was a project I undertook and limited in scope in order to learn how to make games.  For context, when I started the gamedev journey I didn't know what a "sprite" was... I thought it was a thing from Reboot (some of you might not get this reference). Anyways... it's safe to say that Unworthy was a necessary stepping stone that lead to the development of Crowsworn. I can comfortably say that without Unworthy we wouldn't be working on Crowsworn today. 

Although, Unworthy is a much smaller production and I would say is exceptionally rough around the edges, I do think it is also a very competently designed game, and is something I'm proud of. I learned a lot from both the successes and pitfalls of Unworthy, and I put those lessons into practice when designing Crowsworn!

Again, I just wanted to thank you all so much for this overwhelming support!"[/i]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/mongooserodeo/crowsworn-a-dark-and-mysterious-action-packed-metroidvania?ref=1x7fst]BACK CROWSWORN ON KICKSTARTER[/url]

[h3]We're doin' it live![/h3]

[h3]We've hit 500% funding, [i]10,000+ backers and are closing in on our next Stretch Goal...[/i][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40456999/6196dd3727ee4e4a801d04bf9114766099f886ce.png[/img]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/mongooserodeo/crowsworn-a-dark-and-mysterious-action-packed-metroidvania?ref=1x7fst]www.crowsworn.com/kickstarter[/url]

[h2]RUINED LIBRARY + STEELBOOK[/h2]
At $750K CAD we unlock the RUINED LIBRARY on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/mongooserodeo/crowsworn-a-dark-and-mysterious-action-packed-metroidvania?ref=1x7fst]Kickstarter[/url]...

[h3]Quote from Kickstarter (Update #5):[/h3]
[i]This will be a whole new region, with enemies, bosses, and is essentially themed as a dark haunted library. The structure once served as a hub for mages and researchers but is now long past its glory days. You can expect a few new mechanics thrown into this area as well. We've got yet another Livestream happening tomorrow, with myself and a number of Hollow Knight content creators (including yet another very notable speedrunner)! And I'm working on getting yet another race planned for later, too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40456999/feb32a10066f81496476429f08022b5c3d265fd4.png[/img]

[h1][url=https://www.twitch.tv/Leth]Tomorrow's Livestream on Leth's channel[/url]
12PM Pacific / 3PM Eastern / 9PM CEST[/h1]

See you there!
 ~ Leth

notes.title: 9,500 backers in 10 days!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40456999/d019cda1b4c80677cd1f5dda0f9710ceeda60520.png[/img]

[h3]More news, ya'll![/h3]

[h3]We've hit [i]9,500 backers[/i]!![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40456999/0104f76c823ab94885c4a3d48e9c0789650943f6.png[/img]
[i]I'm not salty that I missed the exact number for this screencapture[/i]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/mongooserodeo/crowsworn-a-dark-and-mysterious-action-packed-metroidvania?ref=1x7fst]www.crowsworn.com/kickstarter[/url]

We invite you all - who have [b]wishlisted Crowsworn on Steam[/b] - to take a look at our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/mongooserodeo/crowsworn-a-dark-and-mysterious-action-packed-metroidvania?ref=1x7fst]Kickstarter[/url] campaign. There are some nice bonus goodies you can get even at the lower tiers of the campaign if you back it; for instance... 

[h2]FREE CROWKART DEMO[/h2]
All backers of our Kickstarter (at the Punctual Bird Tier - $20 CAD - and above) will be getting an early dev-build of our "Crowkart" mini-game! It's quite unpolished and still a work in progress, but it's already a hoot to play online* with your friends! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40456999/f566fd9a361d34183fb452caa5643b549bca6dcd.png[/img]

We're honestly [i]not quite[/i] sure what we're going to end up doing with Crowkart just yet; it's been a little side project we've been cooking during our downtime... We're just excited that we have something to give our backers [i]right at the conclusion of our Kickstarter campaign[/i].

* Port-Forwarding know-how required for direct IP connecting.

[h2]GIANT'S GRAVEYARD[/h2]
We're less than $30K CAD away from unlocking the Giant's Graveyard on Kickstarter...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40456999/f1e97a2981ae66fb3b50156810992998772b0c57.png[/img]

[h3]Quote from Kickstarter (Update #3):[/h3]
[i]The Giant’s Graveyard is a special area in the Crowsworn universe that we are all exceptionally excited about. It is a cavernous dark region, shrouded in miasma. The area will come with its own set of unique enemies, mini-boss, and boss. It is a region that will delve deep into the twisted history of Fearrandal. With this new area open, we will be able to open up the Starling backer reward tier. This tier will include everything from the $320 Tier and below, and you’ll get to work with our resident environmental artist, Deryk Buckareff, to design your own personal memorial statue asset (final design must be approved by team) for the Giant’s Graveyard.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40456999/906fd5b9f36820d07078a21b77be4b76a07c9cc4.png[/img]

[h2]LIVESTREAM TOMORROW[/h2]
I'm going to be streaming "Crowkart" tomorrow with a number of Hollow Knight speedrunners, and answering questions about Crowsworn (that I [i]can[/i]) and our Kickstarter campaign. We would love to see you there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40456999/feb32a10066f81496476429f08022b5c3d265fd4.png[/img]

[h1][url=https://www.twitch.tv/Leth]Tomorrow's Livestream on Leth's channel[/url]

Let the games begin!
 ~ Leth
